name: Pandex
description: Official legislation and case law for AI agents (EU, UK, DE, FR, ES, NL, AT, CH and more), straight from the official sources: every past version of each law with its dates, citations linked to the exact passage. Works without a key on the free tier; a free key gives more calls. Endpoint: `https://api.pandex.io/mcp` · [Docs](https://www.pandex.io/docs)
